description: Unit tests for BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl, testing various scenarios including request/response handling, load timing, error handling, and broken connection detection in a SPDY/HTTP2 context.

classes.name: TestDelegateBase
classes.description: A test delegate implementing BidirectionalStreamImpl::Delegate to handle stream events, read/write operations, and track internal state for testing purposes.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::OnStreamReady
methods.description: Called when the stream is ready.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::OnDataRead
methods.description: Called when data is read from the stream.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::OnFailed
methods.description: Called when the stream fails with an error.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::Start
methods.description: Starts the stream with given request info.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers over the stream.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::SetRunUntilCompletion
methods.description: Configures the delegate to wait until stream completion.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::StartOrContinueReading
methods.description: Reads data from the stream until no more data can be read synchronously.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::ReadData
methods.description: Performs a read operation from the stream.

methods.name: TestDelegateBase::GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing info for the stream.
